altText: AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women gathered on wooden cushioned seating above a green coastal bay. Two seated women clasp hands while the other two lean toward them. They wear an ivory mini with green fan panels, a blue-white-red striped cropped outfit, a copper cropped mini outfit and a green pearl-trimmed mini dress, with varied metallic heels and green knee-high boots. Distant fires, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary background effects, not evidence of a real disaster.
